description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Awoken Summoning], [Damage Cap +10000], [Tri-Element Mode (Earth, Water, Holy)], [Feymarch Oath Mode], [Feymarch Oath +10% Boost] and [Feymarch Oath Quick Cast 150%] to the user

description.name: Awoken Summoning
description.text: Summoning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Earth, Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth]/[Attach Water]/[Attach Holy] after using a Earth/Water/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Feymarch Oath Mode
description.text: Grants [Feymarch Oath +20% Boost]/[Feymarch Oath +30% Boost] and [Feymarch Oath Quick Cast 200%]/[Feymarch Oath Quick Cast 300%] after using 1/2+ Summoning abilities

description.name: Feymarch Oath +20% Boost
description.text: Summoning abilities deal 20% more damage, removed if user hasn't [Feymarch Oath Mode]

description.name: Feymarch Oath +30% Boost
description.text: Summoning abilities deal 30% more damage, removed if user hasn't Feymarch Oath Mode]

description.name: Feymarch Oath Quick Cast 200%
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Summoning abilities, removed if user hasn't [Feymarch Oath Mode]

description.name: Feymarch Oath Quick Cast 300%
description.text: Cast speed x3.00 for Summoning abilities, removed if user hasn't [Feymarch Oath Mode]

description.name: Feymarch Oath +10% Boost
description.text: Summoning abilities deal 10% more damage, removed if user hasn't [Feymarch Oath Mode]

description.name: Feymarch Oath Quick Cast 150%
description.text: Cast speed x1.50 for Summoning abilities, removed if user hasn't [Feymarch Oath Mode]
